501(c)(3) (incorporated Manhattan 10003 but cat ops are physically in southern Brooklyn). NICHE: special-needs cats (3-legged, neurological/wobbly, treatable conditions) pulled from NYCACC, plus TNR. Houses cats in 3 Brooklyn Petco catteries. Email confirmed on own site. Verified 2026-08-26. Intake: Adoption/foster application (PDF) emailed to k9kastle@gmail.com Other channel: Cats housed in south-Brooklyn Petco stores Other channel: Sunday adoption events in Park Slope

All-volunteer 501(c)(3) rescuing dogs and cats from NYC ACC, with a focus on treatable special-needs cases (e.g. a dog with a remediable injury). Foster-based plus Petco/adoption-event locations in Brooklyn; no walk-in shelter of its own. Cats make up much of its intake, but it does place dogs - confirm current dog availability. Adopts locally and to other areas where references and a home check can be arranged. Donation requested at adoption.
